$comment: A2UI catalog SOURCE (D2 — the generative-UI path). Hand-authored: which @elabs-ai/components-ui components an agent may name in a surface, which may hold children, and which events a node's `on` map can bind. `pnpm gen` (packages/cli/scripts/gen-a2ui-catalog.mjs) merges each entry with the manifest's prop table + cva variants into core/catalog.generated.ts. Two entries are `builtin` layout nodes the renderer draws itself. A type with `"package": "@elabs-ai/components-charts"` is generated into that package's own `src/a2ui/catalog.generated.ts` and bound there (`CHARTS_A2UI_BINDINGS`); an app merges it with `createA2uiCatalog`, because `ai` may not import `charts`. Keep the list small and real: a type here is a promise an agent will rely on.

Stack.summary: Vertical or horizontal flex group. The default container — put siblings in a Stack, never bare.

Grid.summary: Responsive CSS grid, 1–4 equal columns (collapses to one column on narrow screens).

Heading.summary: Section heading; `level` sets the HTML rank (1–6), `size` the type role.

Text.summary: A paragraph or inline run of text with a type role and tone.

Card.summary: The one generic surface — compose CardHeader / CardContent / CardFooter inside.

CardAction.summary: The header's trailing action slot (a Button, a Badge).

SectionHeader.summary: Title + description + optional actions above a region.

StatusBadge.summary: A closed status vocabulary with icon + text (never colour alone).

MetricCard.summary: One KPI: label, value, optional delta. Put several in a Grid.

Timeline.summary: Ordered status timeline from `items` (title, status, timestamp, description).

EmptyState.summary: Nothing here yet — title, description, optional actions.

StatePanel.summary: An empty / error / loading message panel.

Button.summary: An action. Bind `on.click`; one `variant: "default"` per group.

AutoChart.summary: ONE chart from a serializable ChartSpec — AutoChart picks the mark when `type` is omitted. The chart the agent should reach for.

ChartCard.summary: A titled card around a chart: title, description, source line; put an AutoChart inside.

source.description: Where the numbers come from — always state it.

MetricGrid.summary: The KPI summary row: 2–4 MetricCards, optionally one featured (wider).

featured.description: Index of the tile to feature (0-based).

Sparkline.summary: A tiny trend (bar or line) with an optional target line and normal band — inside a MetricCard or a table cell.

label.description: Accessible name — say what the series is.

BulletChart.summary: Actual vs target inside qualitative bands — the honest 'am I on target?' mark.

comparative.description: A second reference, e.g. last year.

Gauge.summary: A notched gauge for one value against a scale, with optional target and milestones.

centerValue.description: The figure shown in the middle.
